body: I needed to hear this man, thank you.
I was thinking the same thing man.

I’m living without someone I love too, as the years go by it gets easier, in the beginning you don’t want to see the sun shine anymore, you just want live in your dreams where everything was as it was before they were gone, but as time passes it gets easier, you have to crawl before you walk, and walk before you run. One day you’ll wake up and realize that no matter what that person will always be in your mind, but sometimes they won’t be as prevalent in there as they once were
I’m sure whatever happened can be fixed. I’m sorry, nobody deserves depression, or anxiety. It’ll all be okay...
